story.title: Cafe
story.setting: A cosy neighbourhood cafe with warm natural daylight, wooden furniture and plants, realistic photographic look.

subjects.words: the cafe storefront with a navy and cream striped awning, wooden door and small folding tables outside
a latte with a white heart of foam and a green leaf on top, in a white cup on a round marble table
golden croissants on trays in a glass display case on a wooden counter
a young dark-haired barista in a black t-shirt pouring milk into a white cup at an espresso machine
the cafe interior with wooden tables, hanging lamps, many plants and customers chatting

beats.text: Slow push in toward the cafe storefront.
The camera glides slowly through the cafe interior as customers chat.
The barista pours steamed milk into the cup.
Close up, gentle steam rises from the latte on the marble table.
Slow pan across the croissants in the display case.

text:
Nice photos! Before I make it, I need a few quick choices:

1. Shape: wide (16:9, for YouTube/web), tall (9:16, for Reels/TikTok) or square (1:1)?
2. Length: about how long? My plan is one short animated shot per photo, about 4 seconds each (about 20 seconds in total, 480 credits).
3. Sound: silent, background music, or music plus a voice-over? If you want a voice-over, send me the exact words.
4. Text on screen: do you want words in the video (for example the cafe name or a slogan)? If yes, send me the exact words.

My plan for the order: storefront → interior → barista pouring → latte close-up → croissants. Tell me if you want a different order.
